worker_research_contract.completion_rule: A first worker commit can never be accepted. Every project requires a separate corrective commit after mandatory adversarial continuation, followed by an independent metric-by-metric evidence and model audit before reconciliation or publication.
worker_research_contract.quantitative_disposition_rule: Every material number and candidate synthesis must map to a governed observation, source projection, modeled synthesis, metric-specific rejection, or proposed metric-catalog addition. Native-scope evidence is retained without unsupported allocation; eligible exact arithmetic, recurring-tax aggregation and equal-cost threshold, deterministic conversions, bounded sensitivities, and noncausal descriptive county gaps cannot be omitted by blanket model rejection.
worker_research_contract.zero_model_rule: A zero-model handoff requires a complete candidate-model inventory and input-by-input rejections and must be rejected whenever the orchestrator can reproduce an eligible synthesis from retained evidence.
worker_research_contract.ui_safety_rule: Workers use noninteractive retrieval only and must not invoke file pickers, save or print dialogs, visible computer control, browser download flows, or the user's Downloads directory.
